risks.risk: Whether this is only the legs/stand or includes the full machine parts you need (compatibility with your machine).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo showing the exact mounting points/holes and a close-up of the underside where the machine attaches (and confirm the machine make/model it fits).
risks.if_unproven: Price as stand/legs only with unknown compatibility.

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible in photos (wobble, bent legs, loose welds, rust-through).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the stand being pushed/rocked from all sides and showing the legs/weld joints up close.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible minor defects (not guaranteed solid).

risks.risk: Top material condition (cracks/warping) and whether the wooden top is stable.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the wooden top edges and the cut-out area, plus a photo of any cracks or repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear to the top.

risks.proof: Ask for a photo of all included hardware/bolts and whether any parts are missing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as without guaranteed mounting hardware.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the mounting/attachment holes and underside brackets (where the machine legs attach).
Send a short video showing the stand being rocked/pushed to confirm it is stable (no wobble).
Confirm what exactly is included: legs/stand only, or any brackets/bolts/hardware.
Show any visible damage: weld joints, rust spots, and cracks/warping on the wooden top.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a used sewing machine stand/legs with wooden top and metal frame, but brand/model and condition details are not fully verifiable; pricing should be based on the cheapest comparable for a manual vintage sewing machine stand/legs and treated as used with possible minor defects.
